'''Chaeldar''' is a mid-level [[Slayer master]]. She is found in the throne room of [[Zanaris]], directly south of the entrance from the [[Lumbridge Swamp]], meaning completion of the [[Lost City]] [[quest]] is required to reach her. She gives out mid to high level [[Slayer]] [[Slayer task|tasks]], which may only be attempted by players with a [[combat level]] of at least 70.

Getting a Slayer task from Chaeldar is a task in the [[Lumbridge & Draynor Medium Diary]].

Blocking a task with Chaeldar costs 70 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]].

==Slayer points==
Players can receive [[Slayer reward point]]s for completing [[Slayer task]]s—this is based on how many tasks players have accomplished in a row. Completion of a task assigned by Chaeldar will grant you:

==Fairy rings==
The [[Fairy ring]] network is a useful method of doing Chaeldar's [[Slayer task]]s. It has teleport spots close to the [[Slayer Tower]] ({{Fairycode|CKS}}), the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]] ({{Fairycode|AJR}}), and [[Fairy ring|other locations]] to be reached easily for no cost to the player, all of which contain the [[Slayer monster]]s that she assigns and can be easily reached from the fairy ring in [[Zanaris]].

'''Slayer Masters''' are NPCs who serve as guides to the [[Slayer]] skill and assign tasks to players requiring them to kill specific monsters a certain number of times. Each Slayer Master has a different combat level requirement for players to be assigned tasks from them. Slayer Masters with higher combat level requirements will generally assign longer tasks with more difficult monsters. Players receive [[Slayer reward point]]s upon completing [[Slayer task|tasks]] with bonus points being awarded at regular intervals (except for tasks from [[Turael]] and [[Spria]]). These points can be redeemed for a variety of different rewards, unlocks, and upgrades which enhance a player's Slayer experience.

All Slayer Masters sell [[Slayer equipment]] at an [[Slayer Equipment (shop)|equipment shop]]. These items are helpful and sometimes essential to specific Slayer tasks. They also provide [[Slayer Rewards|rewards]] in exchange for Slayer points.

==Turael/Aya==
[[File:Turael chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=2932|y=3537|plane=0|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Turael/Aya.|mtype=square}}
[[Turael]] gives the easiest Slayer tasks and is ideal for lower level players. They have no minimum combat or Slayer level requirements before players may receive assignments. After the events of [[While Guthix Sleeps]], [[Aya]] replaces Turael as the Slayer Master.

Blocking a task with this master costs 40 Slayer points, and the block list is shared with [[Spria]].

If a player of any level receives an assignment they do not wish to do, Turael may consider giving players an easier assignment if they talk to him effectively "skipping" the hardest assignment. However, this only works if the assignment is something that he doesn't assign. For example, if Chaeldar assigns a player [[Desert Lizard]]s, then the Burthorpe Slayer Master cannot change their task, as he too assigns Desert Lizards.  Note that it is impossible for a player to get Turael to reassign a task that he gave out.

He is located in a small house south of the [[general store]] in [[Burthorpe]]. The fastest ways to reach him are to use:

*A [[Games necklace]] to the [[Burthorpe Games Room]], down the stairs and run east.
*A [[Combat bracelet]] to teleport to the [[Warriors' Guild]] and run east.

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Turael '''will not''' grant any Slayer points. As well, if it was a task replacing one from another Master your [[Slayer reward point|task streak]] will be '''reset'''. So, if you're on the 48th task and take a replacement one from Turael, your completed tasks will be set to 0.

==Krystilia==
[[File:Krystilia chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=3110|y=3516|plane=0|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Krystilia.|mtype=square}}
[[Krystilia]]'s tasks come with a risk: tasks assigned by her '''must''' be done within the [[Wilderness]]. She has no minimum combat or Slayer level requirements, and doesn't factor in the player's combat level, meaning she may give players tasks much harder than their combat level would otherwise indicate.

Blocking a task with this master costs 100 Slayer points.

While completing Krystilia's tasks, players may obtain [[Larran's key]]s, the drop rate of which is dependent on the monster's combat level. They can be used to open a [[Larran's small chest|small]] or [[Larran's big chest|big chest]] for additional rewards.

Assignments from her have a separate task completion counter than assignments from other Slayer Masters, so players will have to complete five of her Slayer assignments to begin earning Slayer reward points. If the player chooses to reset an assignment Krystilia gives before the five assignments are completed, the counter will reset to zero and the player will need to complete five more tasks before they will receive reward points.

She can be found by the jailhouse in [[Edgeville]], north-east of the bank. The fastest ways to reach her are to use:

*An [[amulet of glory]] teleport to Edgeville.
*The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|DKR}}, and run west over the river.
*The [[Paddewwa Teleport]] from the [[Ancient Magicks|Ancient Spellbook]], then exit the dungeon and run north.
*One of the [[canoe]] spots on the [[River Lum]].
*[[Lesser Fanatic]] teleport on the  [[Achievement diary cape|Achievement Diary Cape]].

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Krystilia grants:

*25 points per task
*125 points for every 10th
*375 points for every 50th
*625 points for every 100th
*875 points for every 250th
*1,250 points for every 1,000th

'''Krystilia''' is a [[Slayer master]] found in [[Edgeville]]'s jail north-east of the [[bank]]. When spoken to, she expresses her love for [[magic]] and the Wilderness, and claims the guards locked her in the cell for trouble-making.

Players can speak to her to change their [[respawn]] point to Edgeville for a one-time fee of 5,000,000 [[coins]].

Blocking a task with Krystilia costs 100 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]].

==Slayer==
Krystilia is a Slayer master who assigns the player [[monsters]] found within the [[Wilderness]]. '''Only''' kills within the Wilderness count towards her tasks. Before being assigned a Wilderness task, she will warn you that she will assign '''any''' monster regardless of your combat level.

She will refuse to assign tasks to players who are still Level 1 in Slayer, insisting that they first need to speak to the [[Burthorpe]] Slayer Master [[Turael]] so that he teaches the player about the how the skill works. One good way to get around this is by doing the [[Natural history quiz]] at the Varrock Museum, which will give 1,000 XP both in Slayer and in [[Hunter]], bringing both skills to Level 9, assuming both were at Level 1.

Unlike other slayer masters, Krystilia's tasks have a separate counter from the normal slayer masters, thus players must complete five tasks from her to begin their Wilderness point streak. Despite using two different counters, players '''cannot''' have both a normal and Wilderness slayer task at the same time. However, if the player is given a task they do not want and cannot skip it, they can go to [[Turael]] to remove it (provided that he cannot assign it), though this will remove the Wilderness task streak and require players to complete another five tasks from her to start gaining points again.

For a kill to count towards a Krystilia task, the player must be physically located inside the Wilderness when the monster's death occurs. A player who is using a [[dwarf multicannon]] will receive the standard "As your slayer task is from Krystilia, you can only perform it inside the Wilderness" message if they teleport out of the Wilderness to restock and remain outside of it when their cannon kills the monster. The safe zone buffer immediately outside the [[Ferox Enclave]] counts as the Wilderness for task purposes, but the Enclave itself does not. Thus a player using the [[pool of refreshment]] to resupply will not receive credit for the kill if they are inside the Enclave. 

In return for completing her tasks in the Wilderness, players will have a chance to roll for [[Larran's key]] and [[Slayer's enchantment]] drops. Due to the nature of the Wilderness and the varying location(s) of the assigned monster(s), it is recommended that players do not bring items they are not willing to lose, as it is possible to be killed at any time from other players. She also awards significantly more slayer points than any other master.

{{External|rs=Slayer points}} {{Infobox Currency |name = Slayer reward points |release = [[12 December]] [[2013]] |update = First Slayer Batch |aka = Slayer points |members = Yes }} '''Slayer reward points''' are rewarded after every completed [[Slayer task]], from every [[Slayer Master]] except [[Turael]] and [[Spria]]. The higher level the Slayer Master, the more points are received. Additionally, bonus points are awarded after every 10th, 50th, 100th, 250th, and 1,000th completed task. For example, completing 20 tasks in a row awards bonus points on both the 10th and the 20th consecutive tasks. Slayer reward points can be traded in to any Slayer Master for various [[Slayer Rewards|rewards]]. [[File:Slayer reward points (Tasks) interface.png|thumb|250px|Players can cancel or block tasks at the cost of slayer reward points.]] A total of 11,580 points are required in order to obtain all the rewards and blocks at least once. Using a base of 15 points, approximately 461 sequential tasks are required. Excluding the [[slayer helmet]] recolours reduces this to 3,580 points, or around 250 tasks. ==Obtaining points== With an exception of the one-time reward for completing the quest [[A Porcine of Interest]], the only way to obtain Slayer points is through completing Slayer assignments. Slayer points are not awarded for the first four tasks a player completes but are rewarded for their fifth and further tasks. ===Assignments=== If attempting to gain points quickly, players are advised to use [[Turael]] or [[Spria]] for the first nine Slayer tasks and then any Slayer Master that gives decent tasks for the player's [[combat level]]. Notably, [[Konar quo Maten]] gives more slayer reward points than [[Duradel]] as her tasks are required to be completed in a specified location, with [[Krystilia]]'s Wilderness-only tasks rewarding the most points (at the cost of having a separate task streak from normal Slayer masters). If a player is unsure of their current streak progress, they may simply select the "Check" option on their [[enchanted gem]] or [[Slayer helmet]]. Alternatively, when asking [[Turael]] or [[Aya]] in [[Burthorpe]] for a new assignment, they will tell the player how far into their streak they are, but only if the current assignment is not one that they would ordinarily give. '''Do not''' confirm the dialogue, as this will give players a new task from them and reset your task streak. Bonus points are gained at regular intervals, giving a certain number more than the Slayer Master's regular points. Players are recommended to use the Slayer Master having the highest requirements they meet once they approach the final task, due to the large increase in Slayer points given: *5x points every 10th task *15x points every 50th task *25x points every 100th task *35x points every 250th task *50x points every 1,000th task Taking these bonus points into account over the course of a 1000 task streak, the average point gain per task equals 1.775x the base points. For example, Krystilia gives 25 points per task. After completing 1000 of her tasks in a row, a total of 44,375 points are earned, or an average of 44.375 points per task. The process revolves around completing simple tasks as quickly as possible, only using higher tier Masters for "milestone tasks" (e.g., every 10th or 50th task). This allows the player to minimise the time taken between milestone tasks (which award disproportionately high reward point values as shown above). Historically, [[Turael]] has been the preferred Master for this method. However, changes to the reward point distribution as of August 2025 have introduced [[Mazchna]] as a viable alternative. When boosting with Turael or Mazchna, the player should seek to [[Slayer_Rewards#Tasks|block]] tasks that are slow or tedious. [[Expeditious bracelet]]s should be equipped at all times. It is best to seek out the lowest level variant of your assigned monster, ideally in large and tightly packed numbers. A [[dwarf multicannon]] is '''strongly recommended'''; multi-combat zones generally offer the fastest completion rates but the cannon can still greatly speed up tasks in single-way combat areas. Players with 67 [[Magic]] should use the [[Lunar spellbook]] for [[NPC Contact]] to eliminate downtime between tasks. As discussed above, due to the separate task completion counter for [[Wilderness]] Slayer, when boosting with this method, milestone tasks cannot be completed with [[Krystilia]]. [[Konar quo Maten]] is generally the best Slayer Master to use for milestone tasks if the player is eligible to receive tasks from her. While these methods are capable of producing the fastest Slayer reward point rates, they are generally not recommended for players seeking the fastest Slayer [[Experience]] rates. === Turael boosting === Completing nine tasks with [[Turael]] followed by a tenth task with [[Konar quo Maten]], or another master that gives a large number of reward points, is a popular strategy for fast points. '''Konar quo Maten''' (translated as '''Konar the Hunter''') is a [[Slayer master]] who is found in the [[Kahlith]] settlement on the summit of [[Mount Karuulm]]. Players must have a [[combat level]] of at least 75 to be assigned a [[Slayer task]] from her.

Compared to other Slayer masters, Konar assigns [[wyrm]]s and [[drake]]s more frequently and in higher amounts. Additionally, she is the only Slayer master who can assign [[hydra]]s as a general task and the [[Alchemical Hydra]] as a boss task.

Blocking a task with Konar costs 80 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]].

==Transportation==
*[[Rada's blessing 3]] or [[Rada's blessing 4|4]]'s teleport takes players to the summit of [[Mount Karuulm]].
*Heading north of the {{Fairycode|CIR}} [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]]
*North of the [[Farming Guild]] teleport (found on the [[Skills necklace]]/[[Farming cape]])
*North of the [[Battlefront Teleport|Battlefront teleport]].
*Using the [[NPC Contact]] spell. Konar is initially unavailable using NPC Contact and must be spoken to first using Talk-to before becoming an option. The right-click "Assignment" option will '''not''' unlock her in NPC contact.

==Slayer points==
Players can receive [[Slayer reward point]]s for completing [[Slayer task]]s—this is based on how many tasks players have accomplished in a row. Completion of a task assigned by Konar will grant players a varying amount of points, depending if they have completed the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary]]. Although she is the third highest Slayer master, she gives the second highest slayer point reward per task due to requiring players to slay in a specific area. The only Slayer master who gives more points is [[Krystilia]], who gives Slayer tasks in the [[Wilderness]].

==Tasks==
Unlike other Slayer masters, Konar's [[Slayer task]]s also include a specific location where players must complete the entire task. 

After a task has been rolled, a second roll is made to determine the location in which Konar wants the player to complete their assignment. This second roll will check any other additional requirements if a location is locked behind a quest. If the player has not completed the quest that unlocks the respective area, then the task will never be directed there; e.g. a player who has not completed [[Song of the Elves]] would not be offered [[waterfiend]]s at the [[Iorwerth Dungeon]], whereas one who did would have that as a potential location. The chance of being assigned a specific location is equal for each eligible location,{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1621613665072910337|date=3 February 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101215|archivedate=4 February 2023|quote=Yes, it's an equal chance for each of the areas you're eligible to access.}} barring the [[Wilderness]] unless it is part of a boss task (e.g. [[Vet'ion]] task), since [[Krystilia]] specializes in that area.

Bosses that are part of the slayer task area can be killed if offered. For example, being assigned [[abyssal demon]]s in the [[Abyss]] means that the [[Abyssal Sire]] may be killed instead, but if the demons were assigned at the [[Catacombs of Kourend]], the Sire would not be an eligible option. Konar will not be able to assign special locations, such as the ability to kill [[Tormented Demon]]s as part of a [[greater demon]] assignment, since greater demons aren't found in the [[Ancient Guthixian Temple]]. Due to this, players who are seeking to kill variants of monsters are recommended to use [[Duradel]] instead.

In return for killing the assigned monsters at the location Konar specifies, players have a chance of receiving a [[brimstone key]], which can be used to open the [[brimstone chest]] next to her.

Lastly, the [[Slayer cape]] perk gives a 10% chance to be reassigned the same monster for a player's task, including the same location.

'''Aya''' is a [[Slayer master]] who replaces her brother [[Turael]] during and after the events of [[While Guthix Sleeps]]. According to her, she originally was the Slayer master in [[Burthorpe]] before her brother, who was a thrill-seeking adventurer at the time, and that he took over her duties after [[Spria]] was born.

There are no level requirements to receive [[Slayer task|Slayer tasks]] from her, and completing a task assigned by her will always reward 0 points. Blocking a task with Aya costs 40 [[Slayer reward point]]s and the block list is shared with [[Turael]] and [[Spria]].

Because the tasks she assigns are relatively easy, players often use Aya to boost their [[Slayer reward points]]. This is accomplished by completing every 50th task with a Slayer master that gives a lot of points per task, such as [[Konar quo Maten]], and using Aya for the rest of the tasks to get to every interval of 50 more quickly. You can do this every 10 tasks instead but this is not recommended due to the amount of unfavourable tasks that can be given, unless you use a different Slayer master (other than Konar).

==Task changing==
As a Slayer master, Aya fulfills the same role as Turael. She is capable of changing your Slayer task from another master into a less difficult one. If another master has assigned you a task Aya could assign herself, your request will not work. Additionally, Aya will refuse to change her own tasks.

Tasks may be blocked at Aya to remove them from her list of assignments, allowing them to be changed if assigned by other slayer masters.

'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}: After a task change is processed, your [[Slayer reward point|task streak]] will also be reset to zero!'''

Note: Aya is a valid contact for the [[NPC Contact]] spell, and you can obtain tasks from them. It is part of the [[Lunar spellbook]].
